songs.title: Light Left On
songs.tags: Acoustic folk, intimate low female alto with natural conversational grain, stacked harmonies on the hook and subtle slapback echo; fingerpicked steel-string guitar, round upright bass, felt piano accents, brushed snare, muted low kick, warm root drone and pedal-steel swells; close warm natural production; lilting 3/4 waltz around 76 BPM, sparse opening, gradual lift, quiet guitar ending.
